context.audience: locals who walk past on the way to work

concept: On a grey rainy morning, the cafe is the warm light you run toward.
plan_outline: 1. MCU · eye · handheld · rainy street, morning · a woman in a yellow raincoat runs toward camera, rain on her face, laughing (3 s, the hook: motion and a face)
2. WS · eye · static · cafe exterior · warm windows glowing in a grey street, steam on the glass (3 s)
3. CU · eye · static · inside, the door · the brass bell rings as the door opens, rain behind (2 s)
4. ECU · top · static · counter · milk poured into a flat white, the pattern forming (3 s)
5. MCU · eye · push in · window table · she wraps both hands round the cup, eyes closed, rain on the window behind (4 s)
6. WS · eye · pull back · cafe interior · the full room, warm lamps, people reading (3 s)
7. End card (page) · logo, 'Open 7 am · Bandra West' (2 s)
why: Sell the moment, not the menu: everyone knows the relief of a warm room on a wet day.
Warm/cool contrast is the whole idea: grey-blue street vs amber interior, kept in every shot.
One signature detail (the brass bell) makes the place specific and memorable.
The address goes on a designed card; the model never draws the cafe's name.
This is an open brief: in the studio it would first offer 2–3 directions (rainy refuge, the regulars, the craft of the coffee) with this one as the default.
